content: After this horrific crash involving a Tesla driver who said he was asleep and using the driver assist mode, the California Highway Patrol warns that “Despite its name, full self-driving is not fully autonomous. Technology does not relieve drivers of their responsibility to safely operate their vehicles.” Video released by CHP shows the Tesla speeding past flares, cones, and emergency lights where officers were on the scene of an earlier accident, before ramming into the back of a parked patrol vehicle. CHP says two officers were seriously injured in the accident and taken to a hospital. [Media: https://twitter.com/CHP_HQ/status/2110891072620556448] [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7qMjs2JLAyg] Following numerous collisions with parked emergency vehicles, NHTSA launched an investigation into Tesla’s Autopilot software in 2021. It eventually issued a report finding the driver-assist features didn’t do enough to keep drivers engaged, linking them to hundreds of crashes and dozens of deaths when both the system and driver failed to respond. Tesla released an update for Autopilot in 2023 adding more controls and alerts to prompt drivers to be in full control of the car when Autosteer is enabled, but NHTSA then had to open another investigation into whether those changes went far enough.

chineseSummary: 在这起可怕的事故发生后，一名特斯拉司机说自己睡着了，并使用了驾驶员辅助模式，加州公路巡逻队警告说，“尽管它的名字是全自动驾驶，但它并不是完全自动驾驶。技术并不能免除驾驶员安全操作车辆的责任。” CHP 发布的视频显示特斯拉超速 [...]
chineseContent: 在这起可怕的事故发生后，一名特斯拉司机说自己睡着了，并使用了驾驶员辅助模式，加州公路巡逻队警告说，“尽管它的名字是全自动驾驶，但它并不是完全自动驾驶。技术并不能免除驾驶员安全操作车辆的责任。” CHP 发布的视频显示，特斯拉超速驶过信号灯、锥体和应急灯，当时警察正在现场处理早先的事故，然后撞上一辆停着的巡逻车的后部。卫生防护中心表示，两名警察在事故中受重伤，被送往医院。 [媒体：https://twitter.com/CHP_HQ/status/2110891072620556448] [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7qMjs2JLAyg] 在与停放的紧急车辆发生多次碰撞后，NHTSA 于 2021 年对特斯拉的 Autopilot 软件展开了调查。它最终发布了一份报告，发现驾驶员辅助功能不足以让驾驶员保持参与，当系统和司机都未能做出反应时，它们与数百起撞车事故和数十人死亡有关。特斯拉于 2023 年发布了 Autopilot 的更新，添加了更多控制和警报，以提示驾驶员在启用 Autosteer 时完全控制汽车，但 NHTSA 随后不得不展开另一项调查，看看这些变化是否足够。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
